name: Rice Brightening Beauty Cream with Vitamin B3 | Spot-Less Glow & Skin Radiance Formula
description:
Rice Brightening Beauty Cream with Vitamin B3 | Spot-Less Glow & Skin Radiance Formula
Wake up to brighter, smoother, and more radiant skin with this Rice Brightening Beauty Cream, enriched with Vitamin B3 and nourishing rice extracts. This deeply hydrating formula works to improve skin texture, enhance natural glow, and reduce the appearance of dark spots, dullness, and uneven tone. Designed as an overnight beauty cream, it helps restore moisture, refine skin texture, and promote a healthy, luminous complexion while you sleep.
Key Features Vitamin B3 (Niacinamide): Helps reduce dullness and improve overall skin brightness
 Rice Extracts: Support smoother skin texture and natural radiance
 Spot-Less Glow Formula: Helps reduce the appearance of dark spots and pigmentation
 Skin Texture Improvement: Leaves skin softer, smoother, and more refined
 Deep Hydration: Nourishes and restores moisture overnight
 Anti-Dullness Care: Revives tired and uneven-looking skin
 Lightweight Beauty Cream: Absorbs well without heavy or greasy feel
 Daily Use Friendly: Suitable for regular skincare routine
Product Details Product Type: Brightening Beauty Cream
 Key Ingredients: Vitamin B3, Rice Extracts
 Skin Concern: Dullness, Dark Spots, Uneven Tone, Dryness
 Texture: Smooth Hydrating Cream
 Recommended Use: Nighttime skincare
Benefits Promotes a brighter and more even-looking complexion
 Helps reduce the appearance of dark spots, freckles, and blemishes
 Improves skin texture and softness
 Restores moisture for healthy-looking skin
 Enhances natural glow and radiance
How to Use Apply a small amount on clean face at night
 Gently massage until fully absorbed
 Use regularly as part of your nighttime routine
What’s in the Box 1 × Rice Brightening Beauty Cream
Ideal For Dull and uneven skin tone
 Skin with dark spots or pigmentation concerns
 Nighttime glow and hydration care
 Those wanting smoother, radiant-looking skin
